d01-diego-sits-at-desk.observed_description: Diego (dark curly hair with a little grey, short full beard, burgundy button shirt) sits on a light wooden chair at a student desk in a bright classroom, writing in an open notebook with a pencil; windows on the left, a blank whiteboard, other desks empty. Matches his reference.
d01-diego-sits-at-desk.note: Accepted first time: Sit down. / Diego studies in the classroom.

d02-diego-stands-by-desk.observed_description: Diego in his burgundy shirt stands beside a student desk in the same classroom, his hands resting on the desk edge, a closed notebook on it, looking toward the front; clearly standing, face in three-quarter view, blank whiteboard behind.

d03-sofia-writes-name-on-paper.observed_description: Sofia (long curly dark hair, bright blue blazer, white blouse) writes with a yellow pencil on a white sheet of paper at a classroom desk; the line on the paper is a faint cursive-like scribble with no readable letters. Whiteboard blank, desks empty.
d03-sofia-writes-name-on-paper.note: Accepted: Write your name. / Sofia writes her name.

d05-luis-eats-sandwich-at-desk.observed_description: Luis (short dark curly hair, navy crew-neck T-shirt) bites a large sandwich held in both hands at a classroom desk, an open notebook and a pencil in front of him; the sandwich is large and clear.
d05-luis-eats-sandwich-at-desk.note: Accepted: Don't eat in the classroom.

d06-ana-uses-phone-at-desk.observed_description: Ana (long dark wavy hair, sage-green overshirt, white top) sits at a classroom desk and looks down at a smartphone held in both hands, the screen facing her; an open book lies ignored on the desk.

d07-sofia-writes-on-desk.observed_description: Sofia in her blue blazer scribbles with a yellow pencil directly on the light wooden desk top, a dark grey patch of scribbles on the wood, while a blank white sheet of paper lies unused beside it; a bookshelf with plain unlabelled books in the background.
d07-sofia-writes-on-desk.note: Accepted: Don't write on the desk.
